rules.statement: A claim for a share in a well must be for the servitudes of aquae haustus and aquae ductus, and such an action cannot be maintained without co-owners of the servient tenements being parties to the case.
rules.supporting_quote: "This court has held in Singaram v. Shanmugam 1 [(1958) 61 N. L. R. at page 520.] that there is no such claim as a claim to a share in a well except in the limited sense I have referred to. So that the portion of the learned Commissioner's judgment granting a share in the well cannot stand on that ground alone."
